Text checked for explicit ownership/percentage language ('PJSC', 'PAO', 'собственност', 'owner') -- none of those tokens appear verbatim; the page only covers Strings I and II (built 2008-2017) by name, not String VI specifically. VI нитка' as its own numbered object of the federal pipeline-transport scheme -- i.e. an object of the Unified Gas Supply System (ЕСГ), which under Federal Law 69-FZ on gas supply is Gazprom's legislated network. status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status=construction on this row is very likely INCORRECT and should change to proposed. Evidence chain: (1) the row's OWN currently-cited ref (the 816-r decree) lists VI нитка only among PLANNED objects, with no construction language -- the existing citation does not actually support the recorded value; (2) the repealed 2013 decree's original phased national schedule always scheduled VI to start construction LAST, after III (2017-2019), IV (2021-2023) and V (2025-2027) -- VI was slated for 2029-2031, i.e. 'after 2030' commissioning, which is implausible alongside a genuine present-tense construction status in 2026; (3) every dated 2024-2025 primary/press source found and read in full while researching this family's shared documents (neftegaz.ru 866655 2024-11-19; bnkomi.ru 2025-07-01; plus turbodon.ru, sever-press, komiinform pages fetched and checked) reports construction/survey activity for String III (P2287) specifically and ONLY String III -- none names IV, V, or VI as under construction or even as having started site works. No source found anywhere states VI нитка construction has begun. WebSearch(ru) run specifically for newer/contradicting evidence on this point turned up nothing dated later or more specific than the above. Given the implausible ordering (VI ahead of IV and V, which are both correctly recorded as still proposed) and the absence of any construction evidence for VI specifically, recommending Status change to proposed -- most likely explanation is that VI's row picked up an erroneous status at some point (possibly confused with III/P2287, the only string genuinely under construction), or Status/ProjectID mismapping among the family's four rows during initial GEM entry. See fills[] for the Owner reference and validity[] for the family's existence confirmation and the separate Length[ref] misattribution finding (also traced to a III-vs-sibling-string confusion, same root cause class).

cross_row_leads.facts: While researching the Bovanenkovo-Ukhta IV/V/VI family (P5402/P5403/P5404), the current 816-r decree's annex (sudact.ru mirror + live consultant.ru, amended through 17.12.2025) was found to state an outlier capacity for String III's own entry: 'проектный объем транспортировки газа - 619,2 млрд. куб. метров в год' (619.2 bcm/y) -- vs. 60.00 bcm/y individually and identically stated for each of IV, V and VI in the same table. 619.2 bcm/y is roughly 10x the other strings' figure and is very likely a decree-drafting error (transcription/typo) rather than a genuine capacity for III alone, given the near-identical district list and pipeline scale across all four strings. Not pursued further here since P2287 is outside this family's scope -- flagging for whoever next researches P2287's Capacity[ref], since the row's own currently-cited source (if it is this same decree) may carry the same anomalous figure.
